Priya: Hey folks, tiny holiday check-in: are we doing a window-wreath swap at the SF office again this year? I have an extra faux pine wreath if anyone wants it :evergreen_tree:
Omar: I'm down! would love a small wreath. also — who wants to contribute to a shared holiday playlist? :musical_note:
Zoe: @Omar add me for the playlist. I'll add some lo-fi and holiday jazz.
Ethan: Wreath swap yes. also pro snack table. last year's ginger snaps were a hit :cookie:
Nina: Question: are we doing physical gifts or just treats this year? I'm leaning treats + cards to keep it simple.
Priya: Treats + cards sounds great. low-friction. Any allergies/preferences? I'll make a little sign-up form.
DeckBot: Poll created: "Wreath swap + playlist + snacks?" Options: :one: Wreath only, :two: Playlist + snacks, :three: All of the above, :four: Skip this year — vote with emoji.
Omar: Voted :three: 100% snacks + playlist + wreath. also volunteering to lug gear Friday morning.
Zoe: Voted :two: and I'll bring a nut-free batch of cookies.
Ethan: Voted :three: I'll bring tea tins and a tiny speaker for playlist.
Nina: Thanks y'all. quick logistics: plan to set up at 3pm Friday by kitchen table. drop items any time before then.
Priya: Wonderful. I'll DM the SF folks to coordinate drop-off and add a tiny sign for allergy info. Happy almost-holidays everyone! :sparkles:
